page.layout: One title page, one column, centred. From top to bottom: Greek title and subtitle; Latin title block; a line of Cum Indice; a central woodcut emblem with the banderole NATVRA; imprint lines; privilege line at the foot. Library stamps and handwritten signatures are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Cum Indice triplici, primo nominum propriorum: secundo Graeco;

page.notes: A library oval stamp (BIBLIOTECA, ROMA) overlaps the right side of the title block and a round blue stamp sits at the right; both are excluded. Handwritten signatures appear on the left and right beside the emblem; excluded. The woodcut emblem shows a hand and a butterfly, with the banderole NATVRA, which is transcribed. Some Greek accents are hard to make out at this scan resolution; the Greek is copied as seen, but accent placement may be imperfect. The title line "propriorum" is read from the scan and may be "proprium"; it is not marked [?] because the scan is clear enough.
